name: Micah B. Welton
role: Early Ohio convert sent on a mission in 1832
dateNote: He was baptized on 23 June 1831, and section 75 named him on 25 January 1832.
importance: Micah B. Welton lived in Medina County, Ohio, and was baptized in June 1831. Section 75 pairs him with Eden Smith for a mission. He later lived in Clay County, Missouri, and then in Illinois. He was ordained a Seventy in 1839.
connections: His named companion is Eden Smith (75:36).

sources.title: Micah Baldwin Welton, Joseph Smith Papers biography

reviewNote: Dates checked on JSP; death 9 Aug. 1861 in Knox Co., Illinois, read from a cut fragment.
